notes: `no-admin-access` is the one real rule with an empty `allOf` — its cause fires from `anyOf` alone. Also exercises the `anyOf.count / 2` confidence threshold at its edge: `anyOf.count == 2`, so `max(1, 2/2) == 1` and a single match is already enough for `strong` confidence.
